edge_063.relationship: Comparative development and the resources of empire: economic-history questions taken into global history
edge_063.evidence_note: Comparative development and transregional exchange are resources, not a claim that all global history adopts economic modelling. Williams's argument on slavery and capitalism and the comparison of Eurasian economies are among the economic-history questions global history takes up. Pomeranz's own contribution is the separate edge from his person entry (revision 1.130). Huang’s 2002 criticism and Pomeranz’s reply document a later disagreement over the 2000 comparison; neither is a settled verdict or an extension of mapped coverage.
